tinyflows-bus schedule contract v3 carries the job, run and schedule records (CronJob, CronRun, Schedule, DeliveryConfig, ...) with their DateTime<Utc> fields so hosts redeclare none of them. chrono is time arithmetic and RFC3339 serde only, with no I/O or runtime; the schedule maths themselves (cron expressions, time zones) run in the module. Recorded for contract-boundary review (tinyflows#143, openhuman cron cutover #7397).
